docs.label: HSBC Revolution Credit Card Reward Points Terms and Conditions

baseRate.note: 1 base Reward Point per S$1 on all qualifying spend outside bonus categories

bonusCategories.category: contactless/online spend in travel, dept stores/retail, dining (excl. hotel), transport, membership clubs
bonusCategories.capNote: S$1,000/month spend cap (9,000 bonus points) for regular cardholders

bonusCategories.category: same categories, with S$50,000 ADB in HSBC Everyday Global Account
bonusCategories.capNote: S$1,200/month spend cap (22,800 bonus points) for Enhanced Cardholders

rewards.milesConversionNote: HSBC Reward Points to airline/hotel miles conversion per HSBC Rewards T&C; best partners ~2.5 points:1 mile (0.4 mi/pt), consistent with the 4/8 mpd headline rates. No annual fee on this card.
rewards.discrepancyNote: MileLion's article described a temporary promo cap of S$1,500/month (through 31 Mar 2026); current official T&C (effective 1 Apr 2026) confirms the cap has reverted to the standard S$1,000 (S$1,200 Enhanced) - the promo has lapsed.

docs.label: HSBC Live+ Credit Card Cashback Programme Terms and Conditions

baseRate.note: flat rate on eligible dining/shopping/entertainment/petrol if min spend not met; 0.3% on all other spend regardless

bonusCategories.capNote: S$250/quarter cap; min spend S$600/month for all 3 months in quarter (S$1,000 for first quarter as new cardholder)

bonusCategories.category: dining/shopping/entertainment only, new-to-Live+ cardholders issued 1 Apr 2025-31 Mar 2027, first 2 quarters
bonusCategories.capNote: additional 3% stacks with base 5% for total 8%, same S$250/quarter cap and min spend rules

rewards.discrepancyNote: MileLion's 2024 article implied the 8% bonus only ran through end of 2024; current official T&C (effective 13 Mar 2026) shows the additional 3% has been extended to all cardholders issued up to 31 Mar 2027 - MileLion's article is outdated on duration, mechanics/rates/caps otherwise accurate.

docs.label: HSBC TravelOne Credit Card Reward Points Programme Terms and Conditions

bonusCategories.capNote: no cap stated; T&C specifies 5 Reward Points per S$1 FCY vs 2 Points per S$1 local

rewards.milesConversionNote: HSBC Reward Points convert to airline/hotel miles via a separate HSBC Rewards redemption T&C; KrisFlyer rate is 30,000 points : 10,000 miles (3.33 pts/mile) post Jan 2025 devaluation; best partners at 25,000:10,000.
rewards.discrepancyNote: T&C states base points as 2 pts/$1 local and 5 pts/$1 FCY (not miles directly); the 1.2/2.4 mpd figures depend on a points-to-miles conversion ratio defined in a separate HSBC Rewards T&C not contained in this PDF, so the FCY mpd figure could not be independently verified against this document alone.
